title: property-coercion — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the Saved Views property value-typing / coercion ruleset (markdown-dialect.md §3.6.4, MYND-271). Each case is a one-key YAML 1.2 mapping `prop: <value>`; a conformant client parses it under the YAML 1.2 CORE schema, takes the value of `prop`, and coerces it to exactly one Myne property type — string / number / date / list / checkbox. Deterministic cross-client behavior in the password-policy / note-template class (not a codec, not cryptographic). property-index is the single type authority; sibling features consume this typing and never redefine it. Normalized number/date forms are the source token VERBATIM (Myne never reformats numbers/dates; numeric comparison parses to IEEE-754 binary64). Quoting demotes a value out of checkbox/number (forces a YAML string node) but does NOT demote a date. The coercion is extraction-and-typing only — no evaluatable expression / formula. Hand-curated against §3.6.4 (no Rust generator — the coercion lives TS-side in the property-index sub-feature and is asserted against these vectors by its Vitest runner). The Rust reference impl does not exist; this category is a TS-runner category, like a port would run it.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'property-coercion/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_yaml_utf8_hex.description: A one-key YAML 1.2 mapping `prop: <value>` as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex). The coercion target is the value of key `prop`. Hex-pinned so quoting, whitespace, and NFD combining sequences transport unambiguously.

informational_yaml.description: Human-readable mirror of input_yaml_utf8_hex. Informational — the runner cross-checks it byte-equal against the hex; the hex is the contract.

oneOf.title: scalar — pin the Myne type + normalized form of a scalar value

expected_type.description: The Myne property type the scalar coerces to (§3.6.4 Step 3). A scalar never types as `list`.

expected_normalized_utf8_hex.description: The canonical normalized form as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex, empty allowed). string → YAML-resolved value verbatim (no NFC); number/date → source token verbatim (trimmed); checkbox → 'true' / 'false'.

informational_normalized.description: Human-readable mirror of expected_normalized_utf8_hex (informational; hex is the contract).

oneOf.title: list — pin that the value is a list and the per-element coercions

expected_type.description: A YAML sequence (flow or block) always types as `list`.

expected_elements.description: Each sequence element independently coerced by §3.6.4 Step 3 (a list may be heterogeneous). Empty array = the empty sequence []. No list-of-lists in v0.1 (a nested sequence element coerces to string).
